tldr: Venus in the 1st house: love becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Venus in the 1st house, this part of you moves through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Venus describes love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, and what makes connection feel worth choosing. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Venus can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
